Final Fantasy 1 PSP (20th Anniversary) item randomizer with access logic:

v0.1.0.description: # Final Fantasy 1 PSP Archipelago Randomizer v0.1.0 — First Public Release **Release Date:** August 19 **Version:** [v0.1.0](https://github.com/1-800-thewolf/FF1PSP-Archipelago/tree/v0.1.0) First public release. This turns FF1 PSP into an Archipelago multiworld randomizer. Play on your own or with your friends. Chests and Key Items are locations that can hold a random item. You might find an early Canoe and have to sneak into the Ice Cavern early to find your Ship, or perhaps you'll see a spell tome for sale but decide to buy hints to learn what's on a floor of Mount Gulg so you can path smarter. **What is Archipelago?** "Archipelago is a free, open-source multiworld randomizer platform that connects players across dozens of different games simultaneously." Each player randomizes their own game, and items from one game can appear in another player's world. Learn more at [archipelago.gg](https://archipelago.gg). > Archipelago also supports solo play if you want to run FF1 PSP on your own. ## 📺 **Video Tutorial:** > https://youtu.be/06Fc8MNaMPo --- ## Features Play the game how you want and turn on or off any of these game-changing features. ### Open Progression — Ship, Canoe, or Foot? - Open world options let you venture out on foot immediately, allow more options for travel with Canoe, or open up most of the southern continent by foot. - Option to put Northern Docks in the world, providing the option to access more of the game before the Airship. - The Levistone can be broken into shards, so the airship becomes a collection goal instead of one chest. ### Bonus Dungeons - Earthgift Shrine, Hellfire Chasm, Lifespring Grotto, and Whisperwind Cove each carry a configurable number of AP locations - You decide how much of the Soul of Chaos you're signing up for. - Turn them off entirely with one option if you'd rather not. ### Job Scrolls Specialty items that pump up party members. So far, one scroll per job: - Blood Knight — lifesteal and armor penetration on physical attacks - Stealth Ninja — much better steals; damaging floors hurt less or heal you - Grand Master — gains attack and max HP as they take damage - Crimson Wizard — restores mana from damage taken and heals from mana spent - White Cleric — Dia spells hurt every boss, heal the caster, and grant temporary INT - Necrocaster — instant-death spells become reliable, and spells deal damage instead of missing ### More Bonus Abilities - Option to let Monk and Thief dabble in magic. This small boost gives these classes only 1 spell per spell level, but raises their options from 0 (only attack). - Option to let Thief gain bonus crit chance based on Agility. - Option to let Thief attempt to steal extra items after combat. ### Optional Slot Magic Play with the classic NES/Pixel Remaster Vancian system with charges per spell level. ### Take on the Challenge You've Always Wanted - Change Monster Power and Boss Difficulty down to only 10% or turn up the heat, all the way to 500% of the base game's difficulty. - Harder Overworld Encounters and Harder Dungeon Encounters pull tougher hand-authored pools per zone and per dungeon. - Dangerous Forests places scary, hand-picked encounters for those unfortunate enough to find them. - New Regional Ocean Encounters and Northern River Encounters bring hand-crafted aquatic fights to every corner of the overworld. - Boss Minions, ranging from a nuisance to absurd extra difficulty. - Change settings on the fly, such as Encounter Rate, XP Boost, and Gil Boost. ### Shops Built for a Randomizer Randomization doesn't stop at shuffled stock and randomized prices. Purchase AP items from shops, buy yourself hints, and take full control of the quality of the goods for sale, ranging from mundane to exotic to priceless. ### Configurable Goal Choose how many Fiends need to be defeated to break the Black Orb. An option to break the Lute into Lute Tablets. Then Chaos. ### Quality of Life - Super Dash - Spells that miss get colored "MISS!!" text showing how close you were to hitting - Full, custom tracker built right into the AP client. ### DeathLink Severity setting lets you decide how much a death costs you. --- ## How It Works **The apworld** generates your seed like any Archipelago world. **The FF1 PSP Client** manages the randomizer for you. On connect it bakes your seed's settings directly into a patched copy of your ISO, then launches PPSSPP automatically. While you play, it talks to PPSSPP's debugger to watch for checks, deliver incoming items, and keep both sides in sync. Your original ISO is never modified. The client patches a cached copy per seed. --- ## Requirements - **Your own ISO of _Final Fantasy_ for PSP (20th Anniversary Edition), US region, disc id `ULUS-10251`.** No game files are distributed here and none will be provided; please acquire the iso yourself. - **[PPSSPP](https://www.ppsspp.org/download/)** — Windows 64-bit build. You don't need to configure anything: the client patches PPSSPP's ini for you (remote debugger port and memory access mode) on first launch. - **[Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases) 0.6.7 or later** ## Setup 1. Download `ff1psp.apworld` below and launch it, or drop it in `C:\ProgramData\Archipelago\custom_worlds\`. 2. Build your options yaml in the Archipelago Options Creator and export it to your `Archipelago\Players` folder. 3. Generate, then host the output at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads). 4. Open the Archipelago Launcher and select **Final Fantasy 1 PSP Client**, then connect to your slot. 5. First connect only: point the client at your PPSSPP executable and your ISO. It remembers both. 6. The client bakes your seed into a patched ISO copy and launches it. Start a New Game from the title screen. > Full step-by-step with screenshots is in the [README](https://github.com/1-800-thewolf/FF1PSP-Archipelago#installation). --- ## Notes - The client must stay running and connected for checks to register and items to arrive. - Don't launch PPSSPP yourself. Let the client do it, so the debugger comes up correctly. - Always play on the top save slot. Loading a save from a different seed can send the wrong checks. --- ## Something Broke? Run `/ff1psp_logs` in the client's command box. It writes a single zip with the client log, the bake manifest, and the state breadcrumbs the client left behind. Attach that zip to your bug report or drop it in the Discord. It's the fastest way to get an answer. - Bug reports: [Issues](https://github.com/1-800-thewolf/FF1PSP-Archipelago/issues) - Discussion and support: [FF1 PSP Archipelago Discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1500609270620885032) - Not in the main AP server yet? [Archipelago Discord](https://discord.gg/archipelago) --- ## Compatibility Archipelago 0.6.7+ · PPSSPP (Windows 64-bit) · FF1 PSP US `ULUS-10251` Developed by **1.800.thewolf**. Thanks to the playtesters who ran broken builds so you don't have to.

v0.2.0.description: --- # New Features ## 📖 Bestiarysanity — monsters hold checks Turn a percentage of the seed's huntable monsters into AP locations. Kill one, get a check. - Logic handles which monsters are reachable with your items and yaml settings. **New Bestiary tab in the AP client** - Monsters grouped by where you can hunt them. - A section lights up when reachable right now, and grays out when you have cleared it. - Clear over half of a section to reveal the quality of items hidden behind the other monsters there. ## 💣 Traps Replace some of your filler items with traps. Traps spring at the start of your next battle as a **real monster ability**, animated and announced the way the game does it normally. Available traps so far: - 🤐 **Silence Trap** - 🦑 **Ink Trap** - 🧪 **Poison Darts Trap** - 💀 **Death Trap** Because they are real abilities, they can be dodged and resisted like anything else a monster throws at you. ## 👥 Missing Party Members **Choose Starting Party Size** - The rest go **MISSING**: fully removed from the party, and enter the multiworld item pool as items named for their job. - A joining member rapidly gains levels at their first battle victory. - Logic knows your party is short, so a 1-member start does not get asked to do 4-member things. ## 🥷 Custom Job Sprite Special thanks to @✨-Prime-✨ for commissioning the fully custom Stealth Thief and Stealth Ninja Sprites. Get the scroll and your Thief sprite upgrades in game! --- ### ⬆️ Quality of Life - **Item and location name groups.** `!hint`, `exclude_locations`, `priority_locations`, and plando now take group names instead of 323 item names and 452 location names typed out one at a time. 13 item groups (Party Members, Key Items, Weapons, Armor, Equipment, Consumables, Spell Tomes with a White/Black split, Job Scrolls, Vehicles, Assembly Pieces, Gil, Experience Bags) and 35 location groups (Chests, Shops, NPCs, one per dungeon or town, plus Bonus Dungeons). ### 🪰 Bugfixes related to... - Thief steal crashes. - Vanishing party members. - Grand Master gaining attack by lethal attacks.* - Blood Knight lifesteal on undead. - Bonus dungeon chests past the 65th.* - Wrong-disc detection. - Battle turn-order wraparound fix, dynamic chest name fixes, and a pile of smaller client stability fixes. --- ⚠️ Not compatible with existing seeds. Finish the seed you're playing on the version that generated it and then upgrade. --- ## Something Broke? Run `/logs` in the client's command box and drop it into Discord for fastest results. - Bug reports: [Issues](https://github.com/1-800-thewolf/FF1PSP-Archipelago/issues) - Discussion and support: [FF1 PSP Archipelago Discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1500609270620885032) - Not in the main AP server yet? [Archipelago Discord](https://discord.gg/archipelago) **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/1-800-thewolf/FF1PSP-Archipelago/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0

v0.2.1.description: ## New Traps > Hold Trap > Temper Trap Now 27 available traps! Traps are shuffled like a deck of cards, so after you face the Death Trap, there won't be any more of them, unless there's over 27 traps in your world. Here's the full list right now: | | | | |---|---|---| | Blink | Blizzard | Break | | Death | Dispel | Excalipur | | Fire | Flash | Gaze | | Haste | Hold | Ink | | Invisira | NulAll | NulBlaze | | Poison Darts | Protect | Protera | | Saber | Scorch | Silence | | Sleep | Slow | Slowra | | Snort | Temper | Thunder | ## Improved Bestiarysanity - Bestiary Tracker page is better organized and gives more helpful information on where to hunt particular monsters. - Improved bestiary logic to better account for all world/yaml settings - After clearing over 50% of monsters in a region, you automatically learn item rarities for the rest of the items. ## Bug Fixes Related To - Stealth Ninja sprite while KO'd - Canal Bridge - Missing Party Members sometimes being targetable - Traps overriding preemptive strikes sometimes - Overly restrictive placement logic --- 👍🏻 Fully compatible with existing v0.2.0 seeds. Please upgrade mid-run for a better experience.
v0.2.1.title: FF1 PSP v0.2.1 New Traps, Fixes, and Improvements

v0.2.2.description: ## New World-Changing Items - Lufenia Bridge - Lufenia Nitro Powder - Gaia Nitro Powder - Mount Gulg Entrance Key > Lufenia Bridge Links Northern Provoka to Lufenia > Lufenia Nitro Powder Creates a path from Lufenia to Gaia > Gaia Nitro Powder Connects Gaia to Mirage Tower > With all three, you can walk from Provoka all the way to Gaia or Mirage Tower > Also an option to lock Mount Gulg until you find the Mount Gulg Key ## Better Client Messages - I had a lot of debug messages in the ap client window previously, but that's significantly cleaned up now. - Now the ap client actually says useful information for you (imagine that)! ## Bugfixes - Rare game crash related to missing party members - Rare graphical bug with missing party members making it look like they've already learned a spell - Other improvements and bugfixes --- 👍🏻 Fully compatible with existing v0.2.0 seeds. Please upgrade mid-run for a better experience.
